raw: [name="Enya"]Thousands of years ago, Kjeragandr descended into this land, naming it Kjerag and bestowing upon it Her eternal vigil.
speaker: Enya
content: Thousands of years ago, Kjeragandr descended into this land, naming it Kjerag and bestowing upon it Her eternal vigil.

speaker: Enya
content: For thousands of years, Her teachings have continued to pervade the lives of all of Kjerag's people.

raw: [name="Enya"]She gave Her flesh to the Paleroche clan, Her hide to the Browntail clan, and Her bones to the Silverash clan.
speaker: Enya
content: She gave Her flesh to the Paleroche clan, Her hide to the Browntail clan, and Her bones to the Silverash clan.

raw: [name="Enya"]But we all share a common name –– the people of Kjerag.
speaker: Enya
content: But we all share a common name –– the people of Kjerag.

raw: [name="Enya"]Our belief in Her is the foundation of Kjerag, and is also the reason why we stand here today and call ourselves the children of Kjerag.
speaker: Enya
content: Our belief in Her is the foundation of Kjerag, and is also the reason why we stand here today and call ourselves the children of Kjerag.

raw: [name="Enya"]We all harbor the greatest respect for Her in our hearts, and work together to survive in this land to this day.
speaker: Enya
content: We all harbor the greatest respect for Her in our hearts, and work together to survive in this land to this day.

raw: [name="Enya"]However, as we all know now, Kjerag is not the only country in this world.
speaker: Enya
content: However, as we all know now, Kjerag is not the only country in this world.

raw: [name="Enya"]Beyond these snow-capped mountains lies a vast world filled with people who do not look like us, do not speak like us, and do not share our belief in Kjeragandr.
speaker: Enya
content: Beyond these snow-capped mountains lies a vast world filled with people who do not look like us, do not speak like us, and do not share our belief in Kjeragandr.

raw: [name="Enya"]In the past, we've had terrible disagreements over how to deal with such people.
speaker: Enya
content: In the past, we've had terrible disagreements over how to deal with such people.

raw: [name="Enya"]In reality, these disagreements are not an existential crisis. Rather, they are Her way of testing us, Her way of guiding us.
speaker: Enya
content: In reality, these disagreements are not an existential crisis. Rather, they are Her way of testing us, Her way of guiding us.

raw: [name="Enya"]She is the object of faith for all the people of Kjerag, our mother and guardian.
speaker: Enya
content: She is the object of faith for all the people of Kjerag, our mother and guardian.

raw: [name="Enya"]And as a mother, she never wishes to see her children stagnate.
speaker: Enya
content: And as a mother, she never wishes to see her children stagnate.

speaker: Enya
content: Therefore...

raw: [name="Enya"]Do not let your desire to preserve the old prevent you from trying the new. You are Her children, and you should be full of courage.
speaker: Enya
content: Do not let your desire to preserve the old prevent you from trying the new. You are Her children, and you should be full of courage.

raw: [name="Enya"]Do not let your nostalgia for your homeland prevent you from exploring new places. No matter where you go, She will walk with you.
speaker: Enya
content: Do not let your nostalgia for your homeland prevent you from exploring new places. No matter where you go, She will walk with you.

raw: [name="Enya"]Do not let what you already possess prevent you from seeking greater ventures, for you have the right to more in life.
speaker: Enya
content: Do not let what you already possess prevent you from seeking greater ventures, for you have the right to more in life.

raw: [name="Enya"]After all, She is tolerant. The land She protects should be tolerant, and Her people should also be tolerant.
speaker: Enya
content: After all, She is tolerant. The land She protects should be tolerant, and Her people should also be tolerant.

raw: [name="Enya"]By the authority She has vested in me, I solemnly declare:
speaker: Enya
content: By the authority She has vested in me, I solemnly declare:

raw: [name="Enya"]The Vine-Bead Court will tolerate the beliefs of outsiders towards Kjeragandr.
speaker: Enya
content: The Vine-Bead Court will tolerate the beliefs of outsiders towards Kjeragandr.

raw: [name="Enya"]Furthermore, the Vine-Bead Court encourages all citizens to pursue a better life in their own ways.
speaker: Enya
content: Furthermore, the Vine-Bead Court encourages all citizens to pursue a better life in their own ways.
